tests.name: Banking knowledge
tests.question: What is credit risk?
tests.answer: Credit risk is the chance a borrower fails to repay their debt as agreed. It's calculated using expected loss (EL) = Probability of default × Exposure at default × Loss given default.

tests.name: DTI definition
tests.question: Explain debt-to-income ratio in simple banking terms.
tests.answer: Debt-to-income ratio (DTI) measures your total monthly debt payments divided by your gross monthly income, calculated as (Total Monthly Debt Payments / Gross Monthly Income) × 100%. It shows how much of your earnings go toward existing debts when banks assess loan eligibility. This ratio reflects historical debt obligations relative to current income for credit decisions.

tests.name: DTI calculation
tests.question: Monthly debt payments are Rs. 10,000 and gross monthly income is Rs. 40,000. Calculate DTI.
tests.answer: DTI = (monthly debt payments / gross monthly income) × 100 = 25%. Your debt-to-income ratio is 25%.
